item.title: Advanced Combat
item.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
item.description:
Transform your battles with Advanced Combat! Master 3 exciting new weapons and 5 overhauled vanilla weapons, each equipped with devastating, chargeable special attacks. Outmaneuver enemies with swift dodge rolls, land perfect shots using aim assist and experience the action up close with immersive effects and a dynamic over-the-shoulder camera!

- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

faqEntries.heading: Is this Add-On compatible with other Add-Ons and Texture Packs?
faqEntries.content: Yes. Advanced Combat is built to sit alongside the rest of Add-Ons and Texture Packs.

faqEntries.heading: What does this Add-On actually change?
faqEntries.content: Swords, spears, maces, tridents, and bows all gain real combos and special attacks, and daggers, battleaxes, and ninja stars join them. Blocking, dodge-rolls and stamina turn every fight into a proper duel.

faqEntries.heading: What are special attacks?
faqEntries.content: Hold interact to charge a special attack, then let go. Every weapon has its own. A sword lunges forward and cuts through everything in its path, a battleaxe throws a slash that keeps flying, and a mace leaps up to slam back down, etc.

faqEntries.heading: Can I turn parts of it off?
faqEntries.content: Every piece has its own switch. Blocking, special attacks, dodge rolls, stamina, the combat camera and each weapon upgrade can be toggled on its own or tweaked with sliders, so you build the exact combat system you want.

faqEntries.heading: Is it harder than normal Minecraft?
faqEntries.content: That is your call. Stamina costs, recovery speed and every weapon upgrade sit on sliders, so you can make fights punishing, or leave stamina switched off and just enjoy the new moves.

faqEntries.heading: Why are some settings locked for me?
faqEntries.content: Options marked [OP] belong to the world rather than to one player, so operators set them for everybody. That keeps a shared world consistent. In your own world you already have operator status.

item.howToTitle: Advanced Combat Add-On How To Guide

howToEntries.heading: Step 1
howToEntries.content: Create a new world or edit an existing one. Open the Behavior Packs tab, find Advanced Combat Add-On under Available and press Activate. Check the Active tab to make sure it is really on. Do the same under Resource Packs.

howToEntries.heading: Step 2
howToEntries.content: Use the Advanced Combat Guidebook item in-game to learn about the individual weapons and skills. Interact to open it.

howToEntries.heading: Step 3
howToEntries.content: Use the Advanced Combat Settings item in-game to tweak the Add-On to your liking.

howToEntries.heading: Step 4
howToEntries.content: Take what you learned from the Guidebook, craft the weapons and hone your skills to advance your combat!
